## Install
1. Install **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft **1.21.11**.
2. Put these in your `mods` folder: **Fabric API**, **Fzzy Config**, and the `foe-plus-…+1.21.11.jar` below.
3. **Remove FOE-R first.** FOE+ replaces it and uses the same mod ID, so your settings and stats carry over. Don't run both.
4. Join `play.fishonmc.net` and press **O**.

See [FEATURES.md](https://github.com/itshaxr/FOE-Plus/blob/1.21.11/FEATURES.md) for everything FOE+ does.
